params.message:
A source list of 29 Belgian feeds, Dutch- and French-language

Of 115 Belgian sources the Observatory knows, 9 are read, half of the
Belgian signals come from one broadcaster, and none is in French. The
list adds news, music, culture, gaming and lifestyle titles with a live
feed; all enter as proposals, at home in Belgium.

Portal: Een lijst van 29 Belgische bronnen (14 Nederlandstalig, 15 Franstalig) staat klaar om op proef te lezen.
